title: Toggling columns never reorders them (Total always last), and the column selection applies to all four tabs at once
refs: specs/wip-work-in-progress.md Story 8 S8-R5; S8-R6; Story 4 S4-R1
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The Work In Progress report is open with rows in at least two tabs.
custom_steps:
1. Turn several optional columns on and off in different orders (for example, turn on Inv. Hrs, then VIN, then Location).
2. Read the resulting column order after each change.
3. Switch to each of the other tabs and read their columns.
custom_expected:
1. Whatever columns are shown, they always appear in the fixed left-to-right order (WO #, Status, Customer, Asset, VIN, Location, Advisor, Days Open, Last Activity, Labor Earned, Labor Remaining, Parts Earned, Parts Remaining, Earned, Remaining, Inv. Hrs, Total) — the order you toggled them in never changes their position.
2. Total is always the last column.
3. The column selection applies to every tab at once — all four tabs show the same set of columns.
